liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes sweet MIDI sounds in Let It Grow; Reviewer says Bob is awesome on Let It Grow [19][22]
- **Box Of Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Phil's Box of Rain is one of his best performances; Here Comes Sunshine opener beautiful; Reviewer praises Box of Rain with Phil singing [16][22]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer says Phil is going nuts on Wang Dang Doodle [22]
- **Must Have Been The Roses** (1 review): Roses and Memphis Blues are described as very good; Crazy Fingers solid [15]
- **Memphis Blues** (1 review): Reviewer thinks this may be the best Memphis Blues ever, or at least a favorite [13]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Here Comes Sunshine was solidly played, with Vince's playing loved by the reviewer [20]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): A false start to Crazy Fingers showed real playfulness [20]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Spanish Jam incredible and says post-drums is where the show proves itself [15]

## The recordings

- **gd93-03-24.sbd.keyser.25664.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4.15/5 by 41 [1]
- **gd1993-03-24.akg460.swayne.85794.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1993-03-24.akg460.swayne.85795.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1993-03-24.sbd.unknown.100675.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd93-03-24.sbd.nawrocki.16885.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 152 min; rated 3.65/5 by 20 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears a lot of digital noise in the soundboard, but otherwise finds the recording superb; Soundboard has digital noise in Here Comes Sunshine, lasting until about midway through Playin'; Soundboards don't have enough Phil in the mix, and few good audience recordings exist [12][13][14]

## Around the show

- Vince makes nice contributions to the jams [11]
- Attendee's first show since Brent died; the crowd went nuts during the Not Fade Away jam featuring Phil [14]
- Reviewer's group, met through Atlanta, stayed with UNC students sharing a house in Chapel Hill, having tickets but no lodging [17]
- Traffic getting to the venue was terrible, but the energy between band and audience was strong once inside [19]
- Chapel Hill went wild for the Dead; UNC basketball won the national title a couple weeks later [20]
- Healy handed out soundboard patches at the show, so many tapers dropped their audience rigs [2]
- Healy gave out soundboard patches, so soundboard sources were plentiful and many tapers abandoned audience rigs [3]
- Reviewer says this is the show to hear if you've never heard a 1993 show; jams soar [11]
- Reviewer calls it one of the more popular 1993 nights, good but not great [15]
- Attendee of many spring 1993 shows says this one was clearly the best [16]
- Reviewer says it feels more like a 1990 or 1991 show, though Jerry plays a different guitar [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-03-24.sbd.keyser.25664.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Ron Keyser; transferred by Ron Keyser; source: Master SBD > Modified Sony D10 Pro II (lead deck) [1]. Also: Taken from the lead deck of the daisy-chain feed to the taper section; transferred by Keyser via Sony D8 and Sound Forge [1]
- **gd1993-03-24.akg460.swayne.85794.flac16**: taped by Scott Swayne; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8's > Marantz PMD-700 [2]. Also: Uploader walked out with both a soundboard and an audience recording; AKG 460 audience source, 48k version [2]
- **gd1993-03-24.akg460.swayne.85795.flac1648**: taped by Scott Swayne; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8's > Marantz PMD-700 [3]. Also: AKG 460 audience recording by the uploader, down-sampled to 44.1k for CD burning [3]
- **gd1993-03-24.sbd.unknown.100675.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by From Dime-A-Dozen torrent; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: This source was originally labeled audience but is actually a soundboard recording [4]
- **gd93-03-24.sbd.nawrocki.16885.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > D10 proII transfered and encoded by Doug Nawrocki [8]. Also: Reviewer has a clear audience copy of set two only, a big improvement over the Healy mix [16]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dean Smith Center - March 25, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/march-25-1993) [24]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-03-24 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-03-24-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [25]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dean Smith Center - March 24, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/march-24-1993) [26]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-03-24 Dean Smith Center, Chapel Hill, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-03-24-dean-smith-center-chapel-hill-nc-usa/) [27]
